purpose: Separate ongoing live-dashboard data updates from the frozen canonical forward-OOS baseline so operational freshness cannot contaminate evaluation.

canonical_oos.rule: T0 state, pair direction, thresholds, weights, hierarchy and evaluation anchors are immutable during the active OOS cycle.

allowed: Refresh current macro observations for operational/dashboard display
Refresh current COT after official release
Refresh currently validated OIS/CB-pricing inputs where source identity and methodology are unchanged
Update freshness timestamps, source dates and stale-data labels
Add validation-only diagnostics that do not change runtime state or engine rules
constraints: Live updates must not overwrite or mutate canonical T0 artifacts
Live updates must not retroactively alter T0 currency states or pair sides
Live data quality changes remain observational unless explicitly promoted after the OOS cycle
WITHHELD remains WITHHELD when source quality is insufficient; no fallback substitution

requires_oos_restart: Any change to engine thresholds or weights
Any change to Macro/Rates/Policy/COT/Liquidity decision hierarchy
Any change to pair-direction construction or forced-winner logic
Any promotion of a previously diagnostic/non-canonical source into the frozen decision layer
Any runtime change that alters frozen currency or pair state
Any modification to canonical T0 anchors or checkpoint evaluation methodology
checkpoint_rule: Checkpoint evaluation always uses frozen T0 signal state plus the first common ECB fixing on/after the checkpoint date; current live dashboard state is never substituted for T0.
